list.name: code
list.label: Контракт
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT code FROM quik.glass WHERE event_date IN ('2020-03-10','2020-06-01','2020-08-03') ORDER BY code

panels.title: Цена $code и крупнейшие плиты (зелёная — бид, красная — оффер)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(datetime) AS time, avg(price) AS price FROM quik.anonymous_transactions WHERE code = '${code}' AND $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(datetime) AS time, argMax(price, quantity) AS bid_wall FROM quik.glass WHERE code = '${code}' AND type = 'BID' AND quantity >= ${min_qty} AND $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(datetime) AS time, argMax(price, quantity) AS offer_wall FROM quik.glass WHERE code = '${code}' AND type = 'OFFER' AND quantity >= ${min_qty} AND $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Расстояние от цены до ближайшей крупной плиты (пунктов)

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.t AS time, nullIf(o.wall, 0) - p.price AS to_offer, p.price - nullIf(b.wall, 0) AS to_bid FROM (SELECT toStartOfMinute(datetime) AS t, avg(price) AS price FROM quik.anonymous_transactions WHERE code = '${code}' AND $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY t) AS p LEFT JOIN (SELECT toStartOfMinute(datetime) AS t, argMax(price, quantity) AS wall FROM quik.glass WHERE code = '${code}' AND type = 'BID' AND quantity >= ${min_qty} AND $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY t) AS b ON b.t = p.t LEFT JOIN (SELECT toStartOfMinute(datetime) AS t, argMax(price, quantity) AS wall FROM quik.glass WHERE code = '${code}' AND type = 'OFFER' AND quantity >= ${min_qty} AND $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY t) AS o ON o.t = p.t ORDER BY time

SELECT toStartOfMinute(datetime) AS time, maxIf(quantity, type = 'BID') AS bid_max, maxIf(quantity, type = 'OFFER') AS offer_max FROM quik.glass WHERE code = '${code}' AND $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Топ-плит за выбранный период (макс. объём на уровне)

targets.rawSql: SELECT type AS side, price, max(quantity) AS max_qty, count() AS snapshots FROM quik.glass WHERE code = '${code}' AND $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY side, price ORDER BY max_qty DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Дисбаланс стакана: сумма бидов / сумма офферов

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfMinute(datetime) AS time, sumIf(quantity, type = 'BID') / sumIf(quantity, type = 'OFFER') AS bid_offer_ratio FROM quik.glass WHERE code = '${code}' AND $__timeFilter(datetime) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
